title: Placebo Neuroepo multisession Phase II and III
description: A randomized, placebo-controlled clinical trial investigating the neuroprotective and neuromodulatory effects of intranasal NeuroEPO (erythropoietin) in Parkinson's disease patients. The dataset comprises multisession EEG recordings and clinical assessments collected at two timepoints: baseline (pre-intervention) and 9 months post-intervention, with participants stratified by treatment exposure (NeuroEPO vs. placebo). Motor function was evaluated using the MDS-UPDRS III scale, and EEG source activity was examined as a potential mediator of treatment-related cognitive and functional outcomes.
methods_description: Participants were enrolled in a randomized, placebo-controlled study with NeuroEPO administered intranasally according to protocol (Cuban Public Registry RPCEC00000233-En) or placebo. Clinical and EEG assessments were conducted at baseline (pre-intervention) and 9 months post-intervention. Motor performance was assessed by certified neurologists using MDS-UPDRS III item scores. Baseline demographic variables included age, education, disease duration, and motor severity. EEG source localization was performed using inverse solution methods to examine source activity as a potential mediator of treatment-related cognitive and functional outcomes.
